title: Needs you
how: Only what is open for you, oldest first. Each item says what to do, links everything it needs, and gives my recommendation. It leaves this page once you have answered it here or done it.
Pick an answer under each item; a note is optional.
foot: One page, one link, kept current (his order of 2 November). The same list is kept as plain data beside it (items.json) for the advisor's checker.

sections.name: REVIEW: Last week in short: the Monday audit
why: Biggest waste: the Kiln helpers, at least US$1,165 on 17 to 19 Nov.
Biggest risk: the measuring finishing by Fri 27 Nov; tonight's reprice decides.
detail: Verdicts: progress bad (Kiln ended 0 of 6, now paused); speed bad (7.5 measuring hours gave one reviewed solid number); quality bad (the night walk failed three nights on the tester's own tools; last night 14 of 15 stages); your time watch (about two to four of 20 asks were not yours); efficiency bad.

Recommendations, ranked: (1) prove the code measurers and the cheap frame reader today and reprice the measuring with the installed games, judged Friday by rows done; (2) read frames on the monthly API credit so none expires unused (about US$197 left, ending about 11 Dec, assumed), judged next Monday; (3) count the approvals you are asked for each day, judged against today's twelve.
If tonight's reprice shows Fri 27 Nov out of reach at your five-sample rule, one question comes to you on Tuesday with a recommendation.
A fresh reviewer challenged the audit; its disagreements and how each was settled are in the audit itself.

sections.name: DECISION: Install GTA V and RDR2 from your store account for measuring?
why: GTA V, GTA IV and KCD2 in C:/Games carry replaced, unsigned launcher files; the session will not run replaced program files of unknown origin.
Copies from Steam, Rockstar, Epic or GOG carry the publishers' signed files; Sleeping Dogs (GOG) is clean and is measured now.
steps: If you own them on a store: install GTA V (and RDR2) from that store's own app, onto C:/Games
sections.recommendation: Install GTA V and RDR2 from your store account; until then Sleeping Dogs and footage carry the measuring.
options: I will install from my store account (recommended)
Keep GTA V and RDR2 on footage only

sections.name: DECISION: May the session send scripted keys to Sleeping Dogs to measure it?
why: Your 29 Oct ruling allows sending keys only to Marvelous unless you say yes here.
Nothing is changed in the game: no mods, no downloads, only keys from outside and a screen recording.
sections.recommendation: Yes, for Sleeping Dogs and any game later installed from your own store account.
options: Yes, Sleeping Dogs and store copies (recommended)
